newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah bomb wounds two Israeli soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah bomb wounds two Israeli soldiers.

text.p: Two Israeli soldiers were wounded on Sunday when Hizbollah guerrillas set off a roadside bomb near their patrol in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
They said the blast occurred as an Israeli foot patrol passed on a road between the areas of Shkeif al-Namel and Beit Yahoun in the western sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
In Beirut, Hizbollah claimed responsiblity for the attack.
On Saturday, one Israeli soldier was wounded in a Hizbollah attack in south Lebanon, the Israeli army said.
Sources of Israel's surrogate South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia had said three Israeli soldiers were injured in two separate attacks on that day.
Sunday's attack brought to nine the number of Israeli soldiers killed and to 39 the number of wounded in guerrilla attacks in Lebanon since the beginning of the year.
Hizbollah fights Israeli and SLA troops in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide south Lebanon occupation zone.
